title: On the Antiseptic Principle in the Practice of Surgery
lineage: Three PMC original BMJ page images assembled into a PDF; page 246 inspected visually. The original Lancet papers were not directly retrieved; this source explicitly describes and dates the earlier series.

passages.note: Page 246: carbolic treatment of compound fractures; lint dressing and tin cap previously published in Lancet issues dated 16, 23, 30 March and 27 April 1867; later clinical case and treatment details.
